description: Job start orders and also orders for reprioritization contain per queue information.
One or more objects of type OrderQueue are contained in the queuelist attribute of an order.
This information will be copied to the JAT_granted_destin_identifier_list of a running

attributes.name: slots
description: The number of slots a job occupies in the queue / queue instance.

attributes.name: dest_queue
description: The full queue instance name (cluster queue name + @ + host name).

attributes.name: dest_version
description: Version of the queue instance. Is used to detect if the queue has been modified during scheduling.
In this case the scheduling result is skipped.

attributes.name: binding_to_use
description: One entry for sequential jobs or multiple entries for PE jobs in case of host/task specific binding

attributes.name: granted_rsmaps
description: List of RSMAP IDs granted to this job / specific tasks of a parallel job,
which are running on the specific queue instance / host described by this object.
